name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail lost in upscaling by using depth maps, which directly improves output quality without extra compute—critical for EXCAVA’s 0.5% lift. The trade-off is added complexity in the pipeline, but depth maps are already generated for EXCAVA’s 3D work, so the cost is minimal.

name: Torque
text: Depth maps won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core issue is the u-net’s face pipeline isn’t tested under EXCAVA’s *real* constraints—on real-world video frames with motion blur, occlusions, and lighting shifts. Instead, test SD3.5-Ultr’s new face-refiner node first; if it fails, swap in a dedicated face model like InstantX’s face upscaler—its trade-off is higher compute, but it targets the exact failure mode. Settle it by running both on a 10-second clip with faces and measuring PSNR drop before and after.
